name: Structured Mesh Subsampling
aliases: Resampling unstructured dataset using a three-dimensional structured mesh
Structured Mesh Subsampling for Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to render unstructured datasets by subsampling the data into a regular 3D structured mesh, allowing the volume renderer to process a uniform grid instead of arbitrary cells.
summary: Structured Mesh Subsampling remaps unstructured mesh data onto a regular 3D grid, enabling efficient volume rendering of entire datasets without slicing.
